distribution.description: Either a normal (mean + sd) or a quantile set. Quantiles let you express skew and fat tails; both formats are scored with CRPS (a topline) or pooled into the energy score (a profile cell). A point guess is not a distribution and is rejected.

mean.description: Center of the predictive distribution, in the round's unit.

sd.description: Standard deviation. Point guesses are not accepted.

quantiles.description: Levels as keys ('0.05' ... '0.95'), values in the round's unit. Must include '0.5'.

round_id.description: Must match an existing round in questions/. Must equal the directory the file sits in.

entrant.description: Stable entrant id, e.g. gpt-5.5_web or myteam_ensemble. Must equal the file name without .json.

topline.description: The answer to a scalar round. Exactly one of topline or profile is present: a scalar round takes a topline, a profile round takes a profile.

profile.description: The answer to a profile round: every cell the round asks for, keyed by its series id (e.g. civiqs_net_approval_dem), each in the same two formats a topline may take. All cells or none -- the energy score is a norm over the whole vector, so a profile with a hole cannot be scored. tools/validate_submission.py checks the key set against the round's own roster.

crosstabs.description: Optional. Keyed by crosstab name from the round definition, then by group.

notes.description: Free text: harness version, temperature, sampling, information access.
